He carried it up the spiral stairs, set it beside the lamp, and worked the cork free with his pocketknife. The handwriting was careful and small: 'If you find this, tell my sister I kept the promise.' There was no name, no date, only a sketch of a harbor he almost recognized. Elias read it three times, then folded it into his logbook and began writing letters to every harbor master along the coast.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒来。街灯在空荡的马路上投下一圈圈昏黄的光，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，车轮碾过积水，声音很快消失在远处。便利店的灯一直亮着，店员趴在柜台上打盹。高楼的窗户大多暗着，只有零星几盏还亮，不知是加班的人，还是失眠的人。环卫工人已经开始清扫街道，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。早点铺的老板掀开蒸笼，白雾升起，混着面香飘到街上。天边仍是深蓝色，城市在安静中慢慢积攒着新一天的声音。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine counting a stack of blocks by taking one off and asking a friend to count the rest, who does the same thing.\n- It stops when there are no blocks left, and then everyone adds up their answers on the way back."}
